events.title: RUNZ dev stream - Next Fest
events.summary: RUNZ is in Steam Next Fest, and I'm streaming the full game live right here to show people how awesome this game is.Come hang out while I play and try to dive deeper, try out bullet synergies and star upgrades, and answer your questions about the game and its development. Chat is open!Want to play too? The free demo is on this page all week! If you like it, a wishlist helps a ton !

events.title: runz is in Steam Next Fest ! Free demo all week
events.summary: Hey runzies !runz is part of Steam Next Fest, from October 19 to 26, and the free demo is right there on the store page. If you never tried it, now is the perfect time. If you did, it got a big update on October 5, so it's worth another run.Quick reminder of how it works: you survive timed waves, then spend your money in a shop that sells bullets. For the full game playtest, you need to join our discord and the code will be available there. We really enjoy the game in its current state, but we need exterior feedback.
